note: Policy rate history for the rate-differentials page. ev rows are [decision date, new rate, effective date if different]. Fed is the target-range midpoint.

USD.verif: Every date matches the Fed table. It lists effective dates, the decision is the day before.

EUR.verif: Every level and effective date matches the ECB table. Decisions land six days before they take effect.

GBP.verif: Every date matches the Bank Rate history. Six holds in 2026 so far.

JPY.verif: Sep 2026 checked against the BoJ statement, Dec 2025 and Jun 2026 against press and data providers. The Jan 2025 hike was not re-checked on the BoJ site.

CHF.verif: Decision dates match the SNB list. The 0% level and the hold at every meeting since come from SNB releases and press.

CAD.verif: Oct 2025 cut and seven straight holds confirmed. Earlier 2025 steps are checked against the Bank of Canada data feed on every load.

AUD.verif: Feb and May 2025 match the RBA table. The Aug 2025 cut and the four 2026 hikes come from RBA statements and press.

NZD.verif: Sep 2026 confirmed on the RBNZ site. Other dates come from RBNZ-linked news reports and a rate-history table.
